name: Konverter Pro
description: Converts German bank statements (PDF, CSV, MT940, camt.053) and payment-provider reports (PayPal, Stripe, SumUp, Shopify) into verified DATEV, Lexware or MT940 booking files. Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. Without an API key, jobs are anonymous Single Orders for businesses: a free preview, then payment per job through a Stripe payment link (EUR 0.05 per unit, EUR 1 minimum, plus VAT). With an optional Konverter Pro API key (Authorization: Bearer kp_live_...) the user's plan and accounting profiles apply. The API key option is not modelled in this entry.
